sources.title: Learning Spatio-Temporal Transformer for Visual Tracking
sources.access: Primary abstract and official code opened; first template retained, dynamic copies separately updated, lines42-54 and84-92.
sources.role: Separates initial/dynamic memory roles. Does not prove an older automatically initialized template is correct.

sources.title: Learning Target Candidate Association to Keep Track of What Not to Track
sources.authors: Christoph Mayer, Martin Danelljan, Danda Pani Paudel, Luc Van Gool
sources.access: arXiv PDF opened; CVF PDF403; official candidate code opened.
sources.role: Explicit identity propagation of target and distractor candidates differs from merely freezing a template. Already reviewed locally25Oct. Official code245-247 has a high-score single-to-single shortcut; not a universal identity guarantee.

sources.title: MeMOTR: Long-Term Memory-Augmented Transformer for Multi-Object Tracking
sources.access: arXiv PDF sections3.3-3.5 and ablations4.6 opened; CVF PDF403; official code opened.
sources.role: Separates slow object memory, confidence-weighted short-term fusion and learned inter-track interaction. Its learned joint detector/tracker is not a ready FlyVis reader or proof of simple averaging.

decision: Literature and audit inform a common-state three-arm control before any earlier-template experiment; no architecture or threshold was changed.
